definition: [ שָׁלַב ] verb Pu`al be bound, joined (Late Hebrew Punic = Biblical Hebrew; שְׁלִיבָה rung of ladder; Aramaic שְׁלִיבִין apparently only 1Kgs 7:28 ; 1Kgs 7:29 , , ravine, narrow path between mountains ; Arabic is seize, carry off, by force ); — Participle feminine plural מְשֻׁלָּבֹת Exod 26:17 tenons joined each to ( אֶל ) its fellow, Exod 36:22 (both P ).
